title: API Docs
subtitle: Public API for developers: generate temp mailboxes, read and delete messages. All endpoints require HTTPS + X-API-Key auth.
authDesc: Except public share links (token access), every endpoint requires an API Key in the request header. Missing or invalid keys return 401; keys without the required permission return 403.
getKeyTitle: How to get an API Key
getKeyDesc: After signing in, create one in "API Key Management" below (Duke role or higher required). The full key is shown only once at creation — save it. Keys last 1 year and can be disabled or deleted anytime.
responseDesc: Successful responses are JSON; creation endpoints return 201. Errors look like { "error": "reason" } with a semantic HTTP status.
respConfig: emailDomains lists the allowed domain values for creation; an empty emailSubdomainDomains means subdomains are allowed on all domains.
respGenerate: Omit name for a random 8-char prefix; pass "random" as subDomain to get the generated value echoed in subDomain.
respListEmails: Only active mailboxes are returned; an empty nextCursor means no more data.
respListMessages: Received mail by default; add ?type=sent for sent mail (needs send permission).
respGetMessage: content is plain text, html may be an empty string; sent_at equals received_at for sent mail.
respSend: content supports HTML; remainingEmails is today's remaining quota.
respShare: Build the public URL from the token: /shared/{token} for mailboxes, /shared/message/{token} for single messages.
respShareList: Only active share records are returned.
note1: Replace YOUR_API_KEY in the examples with your real key; replace {emailId}, {messageId} and {shareId} with real ids.
note2: domain must be one of emailDomains returned by /api/config, otherwise you get "invalid domain".
note3: expiryTime is in milliseconds: 3600000 (1 hour), 86400000 (1 day), 259200000 (3 days), 0 (permanent).
note4: Pass "random" as subDomain to let the server generate a DNS-safe prefix; it is echoed in the subDomain response field.
note5: cursor is for pagination: pass nextCursor from the previous response; empty means no more data.
note6: expiresIn for share endpoints is in milliseconds, 0 means permanent; share URLs look like /shared/{token} (mailbox) and /shared/message/{token} (single message) and need no auth to open.
err401: 401 Unauthorized: missing API Key, or the key is invalid, expired or disabled.
err403: 403 Forbidden: the key lacks permission for the endpoint, or the mailbox belongs to another user.
err404: 404 Not found: mailbox, message or share link does not exist (share links may have expired).
err409: 409 Conflict: the address is already taken; try another prefix or add a subdomain.
err503: 503 Random subdomain collided several times: extremely unlikely, just retry.
errSubdomain: SUBDOMAIN_NOT_ENABLED (400): subdomain mail is disabled for this domain; retry with an empty subDomain or ask the admin.

getConfig.d: Returns the default role, available domain list, subdomain policy, mailbox limit and admin contact.

generate.d: Omit name for a random 8-char prefix; subDomain is optional, pass "random" for a server-generated one.

listEmails.d: Returns the current user's active mailboxes, newest first, with cursor pagination (20 per page).

listMessages.d: Returns messages of a mailbox; add ?type=sent for sent mail (needs send permission). Cursor pagination supported.

getMessage.d: Returns one message in detail, including plain-text content and HTML.

deleteEmail.d: Deletes the whole mailbox and all its messages. Cannot be undone.

deleteMessage.d: Deletes one message from the given mailbox.

send.d: Sends mail from the temp address; needs send permission and respects the daily limit. content supports HTML.

createEmailShare.d: Generates a public share link for a whole mailbox; expiresIn in ms, 0 is permanent; returns the share record with token (201).

listEmailShares.d: Returns all active share records of the mailbox.

createMessageShare.d: Generates a public share link for a single message; same expiresIn rules (201).

listMessageShares.d: Returns all active share records of the message.
